cases.sentence: Every weekday at 9am, summarise my unread Slack mentions.
Each Monday at 10, list the Linear issues assigned to me that are overdue.
Every Friday at 4pm, find unpaid invoice emails in Gmail and summarise them.
Every morning at 8:30, post a summary of yesterday's Linear activity to #team on Slack.
Every day at 6pm, check Notion for pages I edited today and list them.
On the first of every month at 9, summarise last month's Linear issues closed by my team.
Whenever I press run, draft replies to my unanswered Gmail threads from this week.
Every weekday at 9:15, look at my Google Calendar and tell me which meetings have no agenda.
Every hour, check Slack for messages mentioning 'outage' and summarise them.
Every Sunday at 7pm, write a weekly review page in Notion from my Linear issues.
Summarise the #design channel on Slack.
Every weekday at 5pm, reply in Slack to anyone who asked me a question today with a short acknowledgement.
Every Tuesday at 11am, create a Linear issue for each bug reported in #support on Slack that week.
Each morning at 7, give me a two-line briefing of my Gmail inbox.
Every Monday at 9, archive Gmail newsletters older than a week.
At 10pm every day, list tomorrow's calendar events.
Every two hours, look for new Linear issues labelled urgent and tell me.
Every weekday at noon, label Gmail messages from customers as 'customer'.
Find the Notion page for our roadmap and summarise what changed this week.
Every Friday at 5:30pm, send me an email recap of the Slack threads I starred.
Every weekday at 8, check my calendar and Slack and tell me what to prepare for.
Every Wednesday at 3pm, comment on stale Linear issues asking for an update.
Whenever I run it, read the latest messages in #releases and summarise.
Every day at 9am and 5pm, summarise new Gmail from my manager.
Every Saturday at 10, list Notion tasks due next week.
Every weekday at 6pm, update the status of my Linear issues based on today's Slack discussion.
Check QuickBooks for overdue invoices every Monday at 9.
Every 30 minutes, check Slack DMs and summarise anything urgent.
On the 15th of each month at noon, post a reminder in #finance on Slack to submit expenses.
Read my Gmail and Calendar and tell me if I double-booked anything this week.
